# Visual Office Agent Office Specification

**Status:** approved for visual prototype and contract planning; no functional interaction is approved  
**Version:** 0.1.0  
**Route:** `/visual-office/office`  
**Depends on:** `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` section 9 and `docs/design/visual-office-design-spec.md`
**Mockup:** `docs/design/mockups/visual-office-agent-office-v1.png`

## 1. Intent

Agent Office gives a Tenant Owner one glanceable workspace for governed agents. It is a pixel-art 2D scene with an isometric 2.5D illusion: desks, shared work zones, and agent avatars. It complements the policy dashboard; it never replaces the table/detail view required for audit, accessibility, or precise configuration.

## 2. Scene structure

| Zone | Visual element | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Operations desk | central desk cluster | group readiness and report work |
| Review desk | desk with inbox tray | candidates waiting for reviewer attention |
| Delivery desk | mailbox/terminal | report delivery state, always labelled configuration versus runtime |
| Blocked corner | calm warning lamp, not alarm animation | policy, binding, or source reason needs attention |
| Owner station | selected-agent drawer anchor | a safe starting point to inspect, chat, or assign after the relevant contract is live |

The office must remain compact, one screen at 1280px+ with pan/zoom optional, not required. Mobile does not force a tiny canvas: it presents a scrollable scene thumbnail plus a semantic agent list.

## 3. Agent visual states

| Runtime state | Pixel treatment | Bubble text example | Click outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idle` | seated, calm idle animation | `ว่าง · รอรับงาน` | open profile drawer |
| `working` | keyboard/type loop | `กำลังสรุปรายงานรายวัน` | open read-only work detail |
| `waiting_review` | document tray/pulse-free marker | `รอตรวจ 2 รายการ` | open review context if authorized |
| `blocked` | amber/red desk lamp with fixed icon | `ติด: รอ policy snapshot` | open safe blocker explanation |
| `offline` | dimmed desk, no movement | `ยังไม่มีข้อมูลสถานะ` | show source-unavailable state |

The bubble is a label, not free model text. It is limited to an allowlisted work summary from the server and must be hidden/replaced when stale, denied, or unavailable.

## 4. Interaction model

1. Pointer/keyboard focus selects an agent and mirrors selection in the accessible list.
2. Selecting opens an `AgentDrawer`: name, safe work summary, state, last update, permitted actions, and a link to detailed policy/workflow evidence.
3. **Talk to agent** is disabled until the conversation contract is accepted. It is an explicit send action, never a speech bubble click side effect.
4. **Assign task** is disabled until durable task-assignment admission is implemented. The final form requires title, expected outcome, priority, confirmation, and shows queued/blocked outcome rather than fake progress.
5. Clicking blank space closes selection. It never mutates presence or workflow state.

## 5. Components

| Component | Rendering layer | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| `OfficeScene` | Canvas/WebGL or DOM-sprite renderer | floor, zones, desk placement, pan/zoom if adopted |
| `AgentSprite` | scene node | avatar, idle/working visual motion, hit target |
| `AgentStatusBubble` | DOM overlay preferred | Thai label, icon, keyboard-reachable status |
| `OfficeAccessibilityList` | DOM | equivalent list of agents and actions for keyboard/screen readers |
| `AgentDrawer` | existing Zuri `Modal`/drawer pattern | safe detail, chat/task action gates |
| `OfficeSourceBanner` | existing `Card`/`Badge` | source freshness, demo/stale/unavailable state |

Start with DOM sprites for a small office. Move the scene renderer to PixiJS only if pan/zoom, many concurrent sprites, or richer map animation needs it. Zuri currently uses React 18, so a React-19-only Pixi wrapper cannot be introduced casually; a renderer decision needs its own dependency review.

## 6. No-deception rules

- Pixel movement, typing loops, and desk lights are cosmetic. Only API `visualState`, `workSummary`, and `updatedAt` describe work.
- No agent is shown as working without `sourceState: ready` and a recent status.
- No icon or bubble reveals tenant IDs, LINE group/OA IDs, PII, prompt text, secret references, hidden reasoning, or raw task payload.
- A click never assigns work, starts a chat, sends LINE, changes Copilot policy, or bypasses RBAC.

## 7. Acceptance before implementation

- A user understands why an agent is blocked without reading a raw error or source code.
- The DOM list affords every canvas interaction by keyboard.
- Reduced motion, stale source, and renderer failure each have a usable static fallback.
- A task assignment control remains disabled until its API contract, idempotency, audit, durable workflow, and policy admission have passed review.
